description: exp017 - full 16000-step run of the HyperplaneCodeLUT unembedder at T=32. Backbone identical to exp016 (dim E=D=96, 6 layers, 6 heads x head_dim 16, ctx 512, vocab 32768, RoPE 1e4, untied embeddings, single stream; LUT qk nap4/tph64, v nap6/tph64, out_proj nap6/tph256; no residual_lut/emb_resid). Unembedder = HyperplaneCodeLUT (src/spiky/lutorch/hyperplane_code_lut.py): nap=15 -> V=2^15=32768 logits, n_tables T=32, w_cell_init 0.02, anchor-pairs hyperplane init, T_soft 0.5. Per-code soft-sign scores gated by w_cell, voted over 32 tables; no stored per-cell rows -> ~1.10M unembedder params. Recipe: 16000 steps, device_batch 24 x seq 512 x grad_accum 2 = 24576 tokens/step, LR schedule over the full 16000 (warmup 0.1=1600 steps, cosine to 0.1x floor), Lion lut_lr 2e-4 (LUT tables), AdamW adam_lr 3e-4 (hyperplanes no-wd by name; w_cell wd 0.1; tok_emb/norms wd 0), grad clip 1.0, bf16 tables + fp32 master. Motivation: the 2000-step T-sweep found T=32 the quality/compute sweet spot (beat the best LUT-unembedder 1.8942 @ 67M unemb params, at 1.1M unemb params).
